proposal.observation: Continuous 3-6 already has 10 rings (ring_count_error 0), stage-1 residual 3.2 cm so unfolding stays locked, and the K-row is healthy: all 10 prompts are propagated at one Y (~1547), anchor Y scatter is only a few pixels, and the red/green oblique pair sits on that row at about 6 degrees with a separation matching K_height. The failure is elsewhere. Magenta ring lines are evenly spaced synthetic centres, not fitted vertical joints, and the blue horizontal joints exist only on a subset of rings (upper band around y~790 and lower band around y~2300, mostly left-of-centre). Label bands follow K/B2/A3/A2/A1/B1 but are speckled, and correspondence_f1@15 is 0.467 with chamfer ~66 px while sam_fill_rate 0.649 and depth_nan_ratio 0.105 are secondary.
proposal.rule: When oblique K-lines and the uniform K-row already agree, and ring count is already exact, do not retune unfolding, the radial gate, K_height, angle, or uniform_k_snap. Relax only the detectors that actually failed: the vertical accumulator that produced no lines, and the horizontal threshold that left AB-level joints truncated. The development full-overlays that moved many stages together lowered correspondence and fill even when ring count stayed 0.
proposal.rationale: Vertical Hough at 1500 returned no lines, so ring centres fell back to even spacing; dropping hough_threshold_vertical to 900 (bounds 800-2500) should recover the real seams and seat SAM crops on them without touching stage 1, so ring_count_error stays 0. Horizontal lines already lie near 0.5*K+AB from the prompt row but cover only part of the span; lowering hough_threshold_horizontal from 30 to 22 (bounds 20-60) extends those joints so more label transitions fall within the correspondence window. Oblique thresholds, uniform_k_snap, and SAM heights are left at the reference because the K pair is already aligned.
